label: EMOTIVISM_4, occasion-based meaning…: The particular reading tested by the Frege–Geach argument: an…
definition: The particular reading tested by the Frege–Geach argument: an occurrence’s moral meaning is accounted for by the attitude it expresses there, represented by the constraint that equal meanings express the same attitudes. This is the naive occasion-based hypothesis, not every form of expressivism and not an identification with O’Connor’s separately recorded denial of moral truth value.
